description: Search NIH-funded research projects by keyword, disease, drug, or technique. Returns up to 25 grants per call with PI names, institution, award amount, fiscal year, activity code (R01/U54/F32/etc.), abstract excerpt, and a URL to the full project on reporter.nih.gov. Filter by NIH institute/agency (e.g. NCI, NIDDK, NIAID, NIMH) and fiscal year. Sorted by award amount descending.

agency.description: NIH institute or agency code to filter by (e.g. "NCI" for cancer, "NIDDK" for diabetes, "NIMH" for mental health, "NIAID" for infectious disease)

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year to filter results (e.g. 2024). NIH fiscal year runs Oct 1 – Sep 30

is_active.description: When true, return only currently active/ongoing projects

keyword.description: Research topic, disease, drug name, or technique to search (e.g. "mRNA cancer vaccine", "Alzheimer amyloid", "CRISPR")

limit.description: Number of results to return (1–25, default 10)

offset.description: Pagination offset — number of results to skip (default 0)

name: nihreporter.projects.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: NIH Grant Search
